title: Config kind is org-singleton, not folder-scoped
answers: Why doesn't Config support folders like AlertRule does?
body: pkg/registry/apps/alerting/rules/register.go's GetStorageOptions special-cases config.ResourceInfo.GroupResource() to skip EnableFolderSupport, because Config is a per-org singleton rather than a folder-scoped resource like the other rules kinds.
applies: Only for apps/alerting/rules Config kind (rules.alerting.grafana.app); AlertRule/RecordingRule/RuleSequence are folder-scoped and don't need this exception.
